doc.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997

title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe thanks him on behalf of the archive and they plan a Part Two.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Right. Well great. On behalf of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive I’d like to thank Nick Brignola for joining us.
Perhaps we will do Part Two.
Let’s do Part Two, yeah, I’m ready. I’ll come back with some more stories.
It goes by quick, right? © Fillius Jazz Archive -23-
